name: cris-neckar
description: Optional, read-only MCP server published by Cris Neckar (Partner, Two Bear Capital). Serves the same self-published profile information as crisneckar.vc, with an independent source link for each claim.

tools.name: get_bio
tools.description: Current role, bio, and roles held with dates.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: Papers, blog posts, and talks with venue, date, and link.

tools.name: list_cves
tools.description: CVEs credited to Cris Neckar, each with the advisory or release-note URL that credits him. Optional `filter` substring on id/software.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: Interviews, podcasts, and coverage with links.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Public contact information and canonical links.
